label: Finding-24
title: latvia-offline: Note "the one documented case ... from the agency itself" is contradicted by other site data and captures
description: The claim note and story.json call Latvia the one documented case of government services pulled from the public internet by the agency itself. The site's own nl-offline claim (status confirmed, "Primary statement") rests on Rijksoverheid saying NCSC.NL was taken offline "uit voorzorg"; EPFL's own homepage (epfl-site, 08:19:13Z) says it "has temporarily suspended access to some of its websites"; nord.gouv.fr and rhone.gouv.fr served maintenance pages at 08:19Z on 22 Oct.
